findings.evidenceJa: 無数の蟲が体を引きずる音、数多の蟲が壁を這っていく音
findings.governingReading: Sakura recognizes both countless worms dragging their bodies and multitudes crawling along the walls.
findings.explanation: The English collapses two distinct sounds, motions, quantities, and surfaces into generic crawling.

findings.governingReading: The first chamber given to Sakura was this green darkness.
findings.explanation: The English turns the engulfing sensory image into the room’s ordinary color.

findings.evidenceJa: 獣か虫の残忍さしか持ち合わせない
findings.governingReading: Zouken then possesses only the cruelty of a beast or an insect.
findings.explanation: The English omits the insect comparison that connects him to the worms.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分は汚泥に塗れている
findings.governingReading: Sakura imagines herself physically smeared in filthy mud.
findings.explanation: The English turns her concrete, abject self-image into a generic moral label.

findings.governingReading: Sakura imagines that a more suitable person must sit beside Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English changes the domestic, settled image of sitting at his side into merely standing nearby.

findings.highlight: It’ll all be ruined if she wishes for anything more
findings.evidenceJa: それ以上の幸福など、求めては破滅する
findings.governingReading: Seeking happiness beyond merely remaining near Shirou will bring ruin.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the object of desire vague and makes an existing “all” get ruined rather than desire itself leading to destruction.

findings.highlight: Looking at all the Masters in this war, the daughter of Tohsaka is looking pretty good
findings.evidenceJa: 今回の依り代の中では、遠坂の娘はなかなかに上級
findings.governingReading: Among this war’s vessels, Rin is quite high-grade.
findings.explanation: The English identifies the vessels as Masters and reduces technical rank to casual attractiveness or performance.

findings.highlight: the bright future ahead of her
findings.evidenceJa: 憎み続けてきた輝かしい未来
findings.governingReading: Sakura includes the radiant future she has gone on hating among everything Rin possesses and erases from her sight.
findings.explanation: The English makes it a bright future ahead of Sakura and deletes the hatred defining her envy of Rin.

findings.highlight: The words make her dizzy and nauseous
findings.evidenceJa: 目眩を覚えて、彼女は吐いた
findings.governingReading: The words make Sakura dizzy and she vomits.
findings.explanation: The English reduces an enacted physical symptom to feeling nauseated.

findings.evidenceJa: 治療台に寝かされていた
findings.governingReading: Sakura finds herself laid out on a treatment table.
findings.explanation: The English says she is sleeping despite the line occurring after she opens her eyes, and changes treatment to surgery.

findings.highlight: a black priest she has never seen before
findings.evidenceJa: 自分と同じような、見たことのない神父
findings.governingReading: Sakura sees an unknown priest who is “black” in a way resembling herself.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the self-comparison that motivates her perception of Kirei.

findings.highlight: Emiya Shirou will suffer more if you live
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎も苦しむだろう
findings.governingReading: If Sakura lives, Shirou too will suffer.
findings.explanation: The English adds a comparative increase not stated in the source.

findings.evidenceJa: 陰鬱な笑いをかみ殺しながら
findings.governingReading: Kirei suppresses a gloomy or sinister laugh as he leaves for the courtyard.
findings.explanation: The English replaces restrained dark laughter with an ordinary smile and omits his destination.
